dataset_role: Large local confidence corpus for representative election-stream MP4 scenarios.
storage_policy: Local opt-in fixtures. Do not run the full corpus in default unit tests or lightweight CI.
extension_rules: Keep one stable source_id per real-world source scenario.
Put clean source clips in local_files/source and derived clips in the matching artifact folder.
Add every new MP4 to this manifest and expected_results.json before using it in tests.
Mark borderline clips as threshold_dependent or borderline_or_metric_only instead of forcing fake certainty.
Keep full-corpus tests opt-in because this dataset is intentionally large.

source_fixtures.description: Quiet/static polling-room baseline with very low motion.
Close table/document review with people and papers near camera.
Crowded close table with ballot/document handling and frequent motion.
Wide room view with persistent foreground observer/partial occlusion.
Stable document-handling table scene with normal polling-room activity.
Messy real-world table activity with motion, occlusion, and natural blur.
